blocks.text: Pani acid bhi ban sakta hai aur base bhi; yeh baat pani ki quality ke liye ahem hai. Pani ki self-ionisation (Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴, 25°C par) pH scale ki bunyaad hai. Zyada tar aquatic life (pani ke jaandaar) pH ke upar neeche hone (pH fluctuations) se bohat affect hoti hai. Misal: acid rain (tezabi barish) mein sulphur dioxide (SO₂) aur nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) ghule hote hain; yeh pani mein hydronium ions (H₃O⁺) ki concentration barha dete hain. Yeh acidity zehreeli heavy metal compounds, jaise aluminium hydroxide aur lead salts, ko sediments (tah ki mitti) se nikal kar pani mein le aati hai: protonation se un ki solubility (ghulne ki salahiyat) barh jati hai, ya woh mineral surfaces (mineral ki satah) se hat jate hain.
